topic: Checking a Used Couch before Buying It Online

script.title: CHECKING A USED COUCH
script.scene_zh: 住家門廊 · 驗貨議價
script.story_hook: She checks every cushion before she buys.
script.intro_zh: 入手前，每個坐墊都得先檢查一遍。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's a used-furniture checkup. Listen for checking and paying safely.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天是二手沙發的驗貨場景。留意檢查與安全交易的說法。
script.outro: And that's a couch checked and bought. Listen again, then try it aloud.
script.outro_zh: 一張沙發就這樣驗好、買定了。再聽一次，然後大聲試試看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a friendly middle-aged woman in her mid forties with shoulder-length wavy dark hair with soft grey roots, a lavender zip hoodie, black leggings, chunky white running shoes, and a curvy athletic build
script.char_b_description: a laid-back young man in his late twenties with a short buzzed black haircut, a scruffy beard, an open olive flannel shirt over a plain white tank, faded jeans, and a broad muscular build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I texted about the beige couch?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈtɛkstəd əˈbaʊt ðə beɪdʒ kaʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我之前用訊息問過那張米色沙發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah! You're the first one today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ jʊɹ ðə fɝst wʌn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對呀！你是今天第一個到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for waiting out here on the porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈweɪtɪŋ aʊt hɪɹ ɑn ðə pɔɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你在門廊外頭等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No big, parking's easier out front.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪɡ ˈpɑɹkɪŋz ˈiziɚ aʊt frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，前面停車比較方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, mind if I look it over first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪnd ɪf aɪ lʊk ɪt ˈoʊvɚ fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以先檢查一下它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go for it, I'd check anything too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ fɔɹ ɪt aɪd tʃɛk ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 請便，換作是我也會檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the cushions feel pretty firm still.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə ˈkʊʃənz fil ˈpɹɪti fɝm stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，坐墊摸起來還蠻硬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we barely sat on it, honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi ˈbɛɹli sæt ɑn ɪt ˈɑnəst/
dialogue.zh: 那很好，我們平常很少坐它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seats... hmm, is this a coffee stain?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sits həm ɪz ðɪs ə ˈkɔfi steɪn/
dialogue.zh: 坐墊這裡……嗯，這是咖啡漬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that spot? Blot it, it fades a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðʌt spɑt blɑt ɪt ɪt feɪdz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個污漬？擦一下會淡一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's small, but it'll bother me daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts smɔl bʌt ɪtl ˈbɑɾɚ mi ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 小歸小，但我每天看到會介意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear you, we tried everything on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪɹ ju wi tɹaɪd ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我們什麼方法都試過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I can cover it with a throw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪ kən ˈkʌvɚ ɪt wɪð ə θroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 也許我可以蓋條毯子遮一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, a blanket can hide it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ə ˈblæŋkɪt kən haɪd ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 對，毯子一蓋就幾乎看不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, um, can I give it a quick sniff?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm kən aɪ ɡɪv ɪt ə kwɪk snɪf/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，我可以聞一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, sure, no dogs, but go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃʊɹ noʊ dɔɡz bʌt ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，當然可以，家裡沒養狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any smokers in the house before?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈsmoʊkɚz ɪn ðə haʊs bɪˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 之前家裡有人抽菸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, never, it smells just like fresh air.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ˈnɛvɚ ɪt smɛlz dʒʌst laɪk fɹɛʃ ɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，聞起來就像新鮮空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that was my biggest worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðʌt wəz maɪ bɪˈɡɛst ˈwɝi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我最擔心的就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People ask that a lot, it's clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl æsk ðæt ə lɑt ɪts klin/
dialogue.zh: 常有人這麼問，它很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So why are you letting it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ waɪ ɑr ju ˈlɛɾɪŋ ɪt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那你們為什麼要賣掉它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're moving to a smaller place, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ˈmuviŋ tə ə ˈsmɔləɹ pleɪs ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 我們要搬到小一點的地方，是可惜啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that makes sense. When do you move?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt meɪks sɛns wɛn du ju muv/
dialogue.zh: 啊，原來如此。你們幾時搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, so it has to leave by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ soʊ ɪt hæz tə liv baɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 週五，所以到時一定要搬走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's soon. Can it fit in my SUV?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts sun kən ɪt fɪt ɪn maɪ ˌɛs ju ˈvi/
dialogue.zh: 好快。我的休旅車裝得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, you'd need the back seats flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹli jud nid ðə bæk sits flæt/
dialogue.zh: 勉強可以，後座得放平才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I don't really have a big truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ doʊnt ˈɹiəli hæv ə bɪɡ tɹʌk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我其實沒有大卡車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do have a truck, I can deliver it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du hæv ə tɹʌk aɪ kən dɪˈlɪvɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們有卡車，我可以幫你送到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can? For how much, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn fɔɹ haʊ mʌtʃ ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 你們可以？大概要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, since it's just down the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti sɪns ɪts dʒʌst daʊn ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 二十美元，反正就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty's fine, that saves me a rental.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛntiz faɪn ðæt seɪvz mi ə ˈɹɛntəl/
dialogue.zh: 二十可以，那我就省了租車的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. Where can we drop it off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi wɛɹ kæn wi drɑp ɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 那要送到哪裡去？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My apartment, ground floor, gate's open.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ əˈpɑɹtmənt ɡɹaʊnd flɔɹ ɡeɪts ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 我的公寓，一樓，大門開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we'll carry it right in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wil ˈkæɹi ɪt ɹaɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好極了，我們直接搬進屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you carry it inside? That's huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ju ˈkæɹi ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðæts hjudʒ/
dialogue.zh: 你們搬進屋裡？那太貼心啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, two of us, it's no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp tu ʌv ʌs ɪts noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們兩個人，不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Okay, about the money...
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。那好，關於錢……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two-fifty, and that's as is.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪfti ænd ðæts æz ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 二百五十，現況出售。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, given that stain... can you do two-twenty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɡɪvən ðæt steɪn kæn ju du tu ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，考慮那個污漬……二百二可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, two-thirty and it's yours today.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm tu ˈθɝɾi ænd ɪts jʊɹz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，二百三，今天就成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, two-thirty works for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil tu ˈθɝɾi wɝks fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 成交，二百三我能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet. How do you want to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /swit haʊ du ju wɑnt tə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你想怎麼付款？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash, but can we keep it out here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ bʌt kæn wi kip ɪt aʊt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 現金，不過可以在外面交易嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out here? On the porch, you mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt hɪɹ ɑn ðə pɔɹtʃ ju min/
dialogue.zh: 外面？你是說在這個門廊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, I'd rather not step inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ aɪd ˈɹæðɚ nɑt stɛp ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，我比較不想進到屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fair, I get the safety thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli fɛɹ aɪ ɡɛt ðə ˈseɪfti θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 完全理解，安全第一嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll hand it right by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪl hænd ɪt ɹaɪt baɪ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，錢我就在門口交給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool, I'll count it and write a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul aɪl kaʊnt ɪt ænd raɪt ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我數一數，再寫張收條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A note? Like a simple bill of sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊt laɪk ə ˈsɪmpəl bɪl əv seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 收條？就像簡單的交易憑證那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, proves neither of us gets scammed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ pruvz ˈniðɚ əv ʌs ɡɛts skæmd/
dialogue.zh: 對，證明買賣雙方都沒有受騙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Can I grab a photo of the tags?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt kən aɪ ɡɹæb ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə tæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。我可以幫標籤拍張照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brand tag? Sure, it's a nice one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brænd tæɡ ʃʊɹ ɪts ə naɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 品牌標籤？當然，那牌子不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is, and the color fits my wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪz ænd ðə ˈkʌlɚ fɪts maɪ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 對呀，顏色也剛好搭我那面牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it's going to a good home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ə ɡʊd hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那它也算有了好歸宿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aw. Okay, Friday, what time works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ oʊˈkeɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ wʌt taɪm wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 好。週五的話，幾點方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noon? I'll text you when we leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /nun aɪl tɛkst ju wɛn wi liv/
dialogue.zh: 中午好嗎？出發時我傳訊息通知你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noon's perfect. Here's my number.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʊnz ˈpɝfɪkt hɪɹz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 中午完美。這是我的電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Thanks for a smooth deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt θæŋks fɚ ə smuθ dil/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，謝謝這趟順利的交易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too. See you Friday, take care!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu si ju ˈfɹaɪdeɪ teɪ kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你也是。週五見，慢走！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Enjoy that comfy old couch.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðæt ˈkɑmfi oʊld kaʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，好好享受這張舒服的舊沙發！

script.youtube_title: 【二手沙發🧐】「我不想進屋裡」教你驗貨＋安全面交💵🚚🎧｜聽完就敢自己去看貨｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Checking a Used Couch
script.youtube_title_en: "I'd Rather Not Step Inside" — Checking a Used Couch Before Buying
script.youtube_description:
「我不想進屋裡」——在網路上買到心儀的二手沙發之前，怎麼當面驗貨、確認氣味、約好送貨上門，還要把現金交易做得安全又自在？這一集用 60 句連續真實對話，帶你從檢查污漬、聞有無煙味，一路聽到搬運安排、面交付款與開心道別。

你會聽到：怎麼翻查坐墊、指出污漬並順勢殺價；「之前家裡有沒有人抽菸」怎麼問；賣家能不能用卡車送到樓下、幫你搬進屋；只有現金又怕不安全時，怎麼約在門廊當面點清、寫張交易憑證。全程都是 A2 初級單字與美國人在面交時真正會用的短句：um、well、so、ha、yeah。聽完你就敢自己開口：Mind if I look it over、Can it fit、How do you want to pay。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀一遍，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I'd rather not step inside" — before you hand over cash for a used couch you found online, you want to inspect it and stay safe. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks through a real porch-side meetup from checking to paying.

You will hear: feeling the cushions and pointing out a coffee stain, asking whether the home had smokers, arranging a truck delivery up to your floor, and settling a cash deal safely on the porch with a simple bill of sale. Everything stays in A2 words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, yeah. By the end you'll own lines like Mind if I look it over, Can it fit, and How do you want to pay.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧二手沙發驗貨英文｜檢查污漬・聞有無煙味・約送貨上門｜面交怎麼兼顧安全｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
你在網路上看到一張很划算的二手沙發，約了當面看貨：要怎麼檢查污漬、聞有沒有煙味？只有現金，又怕進屋不安全，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶你走進一次面交現場，從坐墊手感、污漬殺價、菸味檢查，一路聽到卡車送貨、門廊點現金與收條憑證，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🛋️ 檢查沙發：So, mind if I look it over first?
👃 聞味提問：Okay, um, can I give it a quick sniff?
🚚 送貨安排：We do have a truck, I can deliver it.
💵 安全面交：Yeah, I'd rather not step inside.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、yeah 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，只要跟著這趟驗貨走一趟，下次自己去面交，話就會自己冒出來。

祝你順利買到一張又舒服又安心的沙發。
